svg.title: Analytic snowy and desert terrain bands, updated November 7 2026
svg.desc: Engineering schematic evaluated from the current terrain formulas, showing full biome ranges and a comparison of the former and new red sand cutoff. This is not a game screenshot.
svg.text: Engineering schematic from current production formulas • Updated 7 November 2026 • Not a Minecraft screenshot
Snowy dimension: every ridge reaches water, dappled forest, and snowy forest
Signed ridge period: 1920 blocks. Absolute terrain and habitats repeat every 960 blocks; noise bends their shared X-dependent position.
Z distance in blocks (constant X; phase shift removed)
Per 960-block habitat cycle: lake 558.2 blocks • dappled forest 113.8 total • snowy forest 288.0 total
Desert dimension: every 768-block band spans lake through terracotta
Current land contour: 0.02 − 0.60 cos(2πZ / 768). Height uses DesertHeight.height(land, detail=0).
Z distance in blocks (constant X; phase shift removed)
Red sand cutoff comparison on one rising flank
Same new contour for both rows; this isolates the cutoff change without inventing a previous seeded-noise profile.
Noise-space red-sand width is halved: 0.18860 → 0.09430. On this contour: 38.7 → 19.2 blocks per flank.
Profiles omit detail noise, cave cuts, interpolation and block rounding; those affect exact placed block boundaries.
Sources: DesertBands, DesertHeight, MountainRidges, SnowyTerrainProfile, MountainLakeOffset and the current snowy stretch setting.
